en: Black-and-white postcard view of a long, low building with a steep tiled roof and dormer windows, situated among tall trees. In front is a courtyard terrace with people seated at tables behind a wooden fence, suggesting an inn or tavern. On the left stands a gate structure with pillars, and a tree-lined road runs across the foreground. Handwritten-style captions at the bottom read "Moritzburg" on the left and "Churfürstliche Waldschänke" on the right.
